faq.question: Which fires is a Foam Based Fire Extinguishers extinguisher for?
faq.answer: It is rated for A, B. Always check the label on your extinguisher and never use an unsuitable type on electrical or flammable-liquid fires.

about: Foam extinguishers spray a water-foam solution that forms a blanket on burning liquids and cools solids. They suit Class A and Class B fires such as petrol, oil, paint and wood.
Do not use foam on live electrical equipment because the solution conducts electricity. Check the pressure gauge and service date regularly.
